name: Plugin Card Widget UI
description: DOM structure, drag/resize interactions, and visual states of the draggable/resizable card that hosts all plugins.

dom.root: .card (position: absolute, border: 1px dashed var(--border), border-radius: 8px, background: var(--surface), box-shadow: var(--shadow), overflow: hidden, display: flex, flex-direction: column)

elements.card-header: .card-header (height: 32px, cursor: grab, display: flex, align-items: center, justify-content: space-between, padding: 0 8px, flex-shrink: 0, border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border))
elements.card-title-text: .card-title-text (font-size: 13px, font-weight: 700, color: var(--primary), white-space: nowrap, overflow: hidden, text-overflow: ellipsis, font-family: 'Space Mono', 'Courier New', monospace)
elements.card-btn-minimize: button.card-btn.card-btn-minimize (width: 24px, height: 24px, background: transparent, border: none, cursor: pointer, color: var(--tertiary), contains SVG with line for minimize)
elements.card-btn-fitview: button.card-btn.card-btn-fitview (width: 24px, height: 24px, background: transparent, border: none, cursor: pointer, color: var(--tertiary), contains SVG with corners for fit-viewport)
elements.card-btn-terminate: button.card-btn.card-btn-terminate (width: 24px, height: 24px, background: transparent, border: none, cursor: pointer, color: var(--tertiary), contains SVG with X for close/terminate)
elements.card-edge-e: .card-edge.card-edge-e (position: absolute, right: 0, top: 0, width: 4px, height: 100%, cursor: ew-resize)
elements.card-edge-s: .card-edge.card-edge-s (position: absolute, bottom: 0, left: 0, height: 4px, width: 100%, cursor: ns-resize)
elements.card-edge-se: .card-edge.card-edge-se (position: absolute, right: 0, bottom: 0, width: 12px, height: 12px, cursor: nwse-resize)

interactions.name: drag_start
interactions.action: Set isDragging=true, compute startWorld from element offsetLeft/offsetTop via inverse transform → on mousemove compute snappedWorld = round((rawWorld) / 28) * 28, set el.style.left/top = snappedWorld * scale + panX/Y → on mouseup compute final world coords from left/top via inverse transform, fire onDragEnd(worldX, worldY)
interactions.propagation: stopPropagation on header mousedown; mousemove/mouseup on document
interactions.timing: continuous during drag, snap to 28px grid
interactions.result: Card repositioned at snapped world coordinates, onDragEnd fired

interactions.name: resize_east
interactions.action: Compute dw = (clientX - startX) / scale, newW = max(280, round((startW + dw) / 28) * 28), update opts.width and el.style.width

interactions.name: resize_south
interactions.action: Compute dh = (clientY - startY) / scale, newH = max(280, round((startH + dh) / 28) * 28), update opts.height and el.style.height

interactions.name: resize_southeast
interactions.action: Adjust both width and height simultaneously (snapped to 28px grid, min 280px)
interactions.result: Card width and height updated, onResizeEnd fired

interactions.name: minimize
interactions.result: Card hidden (display:none) and marked isOpen=false by CanvasArea

interactions.name: fit_viewport
interactions.result: Canvas pans to center card in viewport

interactions.name: terminate
interactions.result: CanvasArea terminates card and removes from DOM

interactions.name: focus
interactions.result: Card z-index raised to top of stack

interactions.name: header_context_menu
interactions.action: preventDefault + stopPropagation → Fire opts.onHeaderContextMenu with MouseEvent
interactions.result: ContextMenu appears with Fit Viewport, Snap to Corner, Minimize, Close/Terminate options

states.idle: Default appearance: dashed border, surface background, title text displayed, control buttons at default opacity
states.active: z-index at top of stack (highest z-index among cards), focused by canvas
states.dragging: opts width/height immutable during drag; title-only display in lower-left zone
states.minimized: el.style.display = 'none', isOpen = false, card still in cards array for reopen
states.closed: Card DOM element removed, drag/resize listeners cleaned up, onDestroy fired

rendering.card-title-text: Plain textContent set to opts.title on construction; re-rendered via renderTitle() when title changes. Font: 13px Space Mono, white-space: nowrap, text-overflow: ellipsis.
rendering.card-controls: Three SVG inline-button pairs: minimize (horizontal line), fit-viewport (4 corners), and terminate (X). All have class card-btn. Colors: var(--tertiary) default, --accent on hover.
